newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ABR Info buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ABR Info buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Robert W Baird & Co said it maintained its buy rating on ABR Information Services Inc and said a recent sell-off in the shares reflected a misunderstanding about ABR's accounting practices.
-- Baird said it maintained its 1997 earnings estimate for ABR at $0.78 per share and its 1998 estimate at $1.03 per share.

-- Baird said it supported ABR's position that its method of accounting for revenues and software development costs was proper. It said "an excellent opportunity for aggressive growth investors" had been created by market reaction to a report by the Center for Financial Research and Analysis that questioned ABR's accounting practices.

-- ABR shares were up 1-3/8 to 46 after falling sharply over the last month. The shares dropped 11-3/8 to 44-5/8 yesterday, and on November 13 they tumbled 11 points to 54 on news that ABR had dismissed its chief financial officer.
